about: Fixed nightly evaluation set. Same prompts + same seed every night so results are comparable over time. Prompts with needs_trigger only run when a trained LoRA is active; {trigger} is replaced with the plan's trigger word.

prompts.prompt: Photorealistic close-up portrait of a man in his 30s by a large window, soft overcast daylight, visible skin texture and pores, natural imperfections, 85mm lens at f/1.8, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain
prompts.negative: plastic skin, airbrushed, cartoon, 3d render, deformed, extra fingers, watermark, text

prompts.prompt: Photorealistic close-up of two hands wrapped around a ceramic coffee mug on a wooden desk, morning side light, steam rising, 50mm lens, every finger clearly visible and anatomically correct
prompts.negative: extra fingers, fused fingers, missing fingers, deformed hands, blurry, watermark

prompts.prompt: Documentary-style photo of three colleagues reviewing documents at a conference table in a modern glass-walled office, candid expressions, natural window light, 35mm lens, eye-level, realistic business attire
prompts.negative: stock photo smile, deformed faces, extra limbs, plastic skin, watermark, text

prompts.prompt: Photorealistic small-business storefront on a main street at blue hour, warm interior light spilling onto the sidewalk, wet pavement reflections, 24mm lens, low angle, straight vertical lines
prompts.negative: warped lines, distorted perspective, cartoon, oversaturated, watermark
